substitutions.old:
$registration = Invoke-Command -Session $session -ScriptBlock {
        param($Trial)
        Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        $wsl = 'C:\Windows\System32\wsl.exe'
        $name = 'Debian-Minimal'
        $rootfs = 'C:\controlled-inputs\ultra-minimal-wsl\debian-13.5-amd64-wsl-rootfs.tar.gz'
        $install = 'C:\controlled-inputs\ultra-minimal-wsl\registered-distros\Debian-Minimal'
        $evidence = 'C:\controlled-wsl-trials'
        $listed = (& $wsl --list --quiet).Replace("`0", '') -split "`r?`n"
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $listed -contains $name) { throw 'Debian infrastructure precondition failed: distro is already registered or list failed.' }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $install) { throw 'Debian infrastructure install path already exists.' }
        [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Split-Path $install)) | Out-Null
        $stdout = Join-Path $evidence "$Trial-debian-import.stdout.log"
        $stderr = Join-Path $evidence "$Trial-debian-import.stderr.log"
        $info = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
        $info.FileName = $wsl
        $info.Arguments = "--import $name $install $rootfs --version 2"
        $info.UseShellExecute = $false
        $info.CreateNoWindow = $true
        $info.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
        $info.RedirectStandardError = $true
        $process = [Diagnostics.Process]::new()
        $process.StartInfo = $info
        if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'Failed to start Debian import.' }
        $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
        $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
        if (-not $process.WaitForExit(45000)) {
            $killer = Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Windows\System32\taskkill.exe' -ArgumentList @('/PID',[string]$process.Id,'/T','/F') -Wait -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
            $null = $process.WaitForExit(10000)
            throw "Debian import timed out; taskkill exit $($killer.ExitCode), process stopped $($process.HasExited)."
        }
        $streamsCompleted = [Threading.Tasks.Task]::WaitAll(@($stdoutTask,$stderrTask),10000)
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($stdout, $(if($stdoutTask.IsCompleted){$stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()}else{'<stdout collection timed out>'}), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($stderr, $(if($stderrTask.IsCompleted){$stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()}else{'<stderr collection timed out>'}), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
        if (-not $streamsCompleted -or $process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Debian import failed with exit $($process.ExitCode); streams completed $streamsCompleted." }
        $listed = (& $wsl --list --quiet).Replace("`0", '') -split "`r?`n"
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $listed -notcontains $name) { throw 'Debian import did not create the required registered distro.' }
        & $wsl --shutdown
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Post-import WSL shutdown failed.' }
        [pscustomobject][ordered]@{registered=$true;distribution=$name;installPath=$install;completedUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')}
    } -ArgumentList $trial
if (-not $registration.registered -or -not $cleanup.unregistered -or -not $cleanup.installPathAbsent) { throw 'Debian registration lifecycle requirement failed.' }
substitutions.new: if (-not $registration.registered -or -not $cleanup.registered -or -not $cleanup.wslconfigAbsent) { throw 'Debian2 article preservation requirement failed.' }

if ($remote.runnerFailure) { throw $remote.runnerFailure }
if (-not $remote.candidateResult -or -not $remote.candidateResult.passed -or $remote.candidateResult.observedGate -ne 'P6-PI-PACKAGE') { throw 'Practical-workload checkpoint requirement failed.' }
